introduction.summary: The study assessed ground beetle communities across different habitat types in Gorongosa National Park, focusing on the role of microhabitat structure as shelters for ground beetles during intense drought periods.

results.summary: The study measured various diversity parameters (activity-density (N), Alpha-diversity (S), and Alpha-functional diversity (Alpha-FD)) and trait values (body size and wing typology) of ground beetles across different habitat types and distances from a lake.

discussion.summary: The study measured ground beetle richness and diversity parameters (activity-density, Alpha-diversity, and Alpha-functional diversity) across a distance gradient from miombo forest to floodplains, examining the effects of habitat closedness and distance to lake Urema.
